verdict.rationale: Ironclad exposes APIs, webhooks, and workflow-launch endpoints that could be chained together into background automations (e.g., triggering workflows on events, integrations that auto-block/push approvals), but this is developer-built integration rather than a native 'set up an autonomous background automation' feature aimed at AI-native users. missing for 10: no evidence of a built-in scheduler/agent framework, no first-party AI-agent automation product, no independent confirmation of autonomous unattended operation.
